title: Module test A1.2 · Ask and place

blocks.text: Module test A1.2 · Ask and place
Instructions
Week 28 of the calendar, after verification A1-06 → A1-10. Duration: approx. 75 minutes for parts A/D, plus 10 minutes of oral examination with the tutor. Fix at the end with the solution (Part IV).

Overcoming. At least 38 points above 50 (75%) and at least 2 in each criterion of the headings. If you do not exceed: one week on the weakest unit (table at the bottom of the solutions), then redo sections below 75%. Before we start. For section B you need the script at the beginning of the solutions of this test, read by another person or vocal synthesis.
A · Reading (10 points)
⁧مَكْتَبُهَا فِي شَارِعٍ قَرِيبٍ مِنْ سَفَارَةِ⁩ . ⁧مَرْيَم صَحَفِيَّةٌ أُرْدُنِيَّةٌ مِنْ عَمَّانَ، وَهِيَ مُقِيمَةٌ فِي رُومَا⁩
⁧زَوْجُهَا عُمَر مُهَنْدِسٌ مِصْرِيٌّ،⁩ . ⁧عِنْدَهَا سَيَّارَةٌ صَغِيرَةٌ، لٰكِنْ لَيْسَ عِنْدَهَا وَقْتٌ كَثِيرٌ⁩ . ⁧الأُرْدُنِّ⁩
⁧أُمُّهَا وَأَبُوهَا فِي عَمَّانَ، وَأُخْتُهَا طَبِيبَةٌ فِي مُسْتَشْفَى⁩ . ⁧وَلَهَا بِنْتٌ صَغِيرَةٌ اسْمُهَا سَلْوَى⁩
⁧عِنْدَهَا مُقَابَلَةٌ مَعَ مُدِيرِ مَكْتَبِ⁩ : ⁧اليَوْمَ مَرْيَم فِي وِزَارَةِ الخَارِجِيَّةِ الإِيطَالِيَّةِ⁩ . ⁧الجَامِعَةِ هُنَاكَ⁩
. ⁧الوَزِيرِ⁩
Help: ⁧مُقَابَلَة⁩ muqābala Interview, interview. Reply in English (2 points for complete response, 1 if partial).
1. Nationality, city of origin and residence of Maryam?
2. Where's your office?
3. What does he have and what doesn't he have?
4. Who I am ʿUmar and Salwā? What nationality is it? ʿUmar?
5. Where does Maryam's sister work and where is Maryam today? Who do you have an interview with?
B · Listening (8 points)
Listen to the dialogue twice. Answer in English; 2 points per answer.
1. What is the woman's surname and nationality?
2. What document does the employee ask you for?
3. Who's he meeting?
4. Where's the office? (three indications)
C · Language (12 points)
One point for an answer. Interrogative. Write the question for the part underlined in the parenthesis:
1. ⁧أَنَا مِنْ⁩ ( ⁧لِيبِيَا⁩ ). · 2. ⁧الاِجْتِمَاعُ⁩ ( ⁧غَدًا⁩ ). · 3. ⁧فِي الصَّفِّ⁩ ( ⁧عَشَرَةُ⁩ ) ⁧طُلَّابٍ⁩ . (use ⁧كَمْ⁩ + singular)
Nisba. Write your nationality to women:
1. ⁧سُورِيَا⁩ → · 5. ⁧العِرَاق⁩ →
Prepositions and genitive. Vote completely:
1. ⁧فِي مَدِينَة قَدِيمَة⁩ · 7. ⁧أَمَام المَحَطَّة الجَدِيدَة⁩
To have. Translate:
1. I don't have a car. · 9. I have a brother in Tunis.
Suffixes and iḍāfa. Translate:
1. in his house (of him) · 11. the Ministry of Defence · 12. the new car of the director
D · Written production (8 points)

Write about 60 words, vocalized, to present a foreign colleague or friend invented: name, nationality and residence, work and place of work, family, something he possesses and one that he does not possess. Use at least two iḍāfa, two possessive suffixes and three different prepositions. Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Register 1–4 (Heading of the Plan, Section 6.3). Each missing mandatory item removes 1 Point to Accuracy (minimum 1).
E · Oral production: interview (12 points)
With the tutor, about 10 minutes.
1. The tutor interviews you with personal questions (name, origin, residence, family, work, home, what
You have with you).
2. You interview the tutor with at least six questions, using at least five different questions.
3. Summaries in 30 second the information collected, with ⁧هُوَ⁩ / . ⁧هِيَ⁩
Evaluation: Accuracy 1–4 + Fluidity 1–4 + Speak 1–4. Without tutor the pronunciation remains unfinished until a native speaker is heard, as in the test A1.1.
